# 2 Kings 25 — Disagreement Log
**Chapter:** 2 Kings 25 (30 verses)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA
**Total disagreements logged:** 5

---

## V.4 — "fled by night" vs. "under cover of darkness"
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "fled by night" / **PNEUMA:** "under cover of darkness"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "fled by night" — preserves the Hebrew phrasing without interpretive expansion.

---

## V.7 — "slaughtered" vs. "butchered"
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "slaughtered" / **PNEUMA:** "butchered"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "slaughtered" — the Hebrew *shachat* describes systematic killing; "butchered" adds connotations of disorder.

---

## V.7 — "put out the eyes" vs. "blinded" vs. "gouged out"
- **EMET:** "blinded" / **LOGOS:** "put out the eyes" / **PNEUMA:** "gouged out"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "put out the eyes" — more precise than "blinded," less graphic than "gouged out."

---

## V.8 — "captain of the guard" vs. "commander of the imperial guard"
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "captain/chief of the guard" / **PNEUMA:** "commander of the imperial guard"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "captain of the guard" — established English rendering of *rav tabachim*; "imperial" is not in the Hebrew.

---

## V.27 — "graciously lifted the head" vs. "released from prison"
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "lifted the head" / **PNEUMA:** "released from prison"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "graciously lifted the head" — preserves the idiom *nasa rosh*, echoing Genesis 40 and implying restoration of dignity beyond mere physical release.

---
*— SOPHIA*
